title: Billing Compliance Schedule for Insurance Coverage & Claims: Denial Edits, Patient-Billable Codes and Authorization Periods
content:
Schedule of the denial-related attributes of each payer class under **Insurance Coverage & Claims**. Denial codes are written as the claim adjustment reason code with its group (for example PR-96).

## Edits and patient-billable denials

| Payer class | Test frequency edits (CO-151) applied | Medical-necessity edits (CO-50) applied | Signed ABN option 1 makes a medical-necessity or frequency denial the patient's | Denial codes whose amount may be transferred to the patient | Timely-filing denial (CO-29) ever billable to the patient |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Original Medicare Part B | Yes | Yes | Yes | PR-27, PR-50, PR-96, PR-204 | No |
| Medicare Advantage Plan | Yes | Yes | No | PR-27, PR-96, PR-204 | No |
| Medicare Supplement Plan | No | No | No | PR-96 | No |
| Medicaid Managed Care Plan | Yes | Yes | No | None | No |
| TRICARE Prime and Select | Yes | Yes | No | PR-27, PR-96, PR-204 | No |
| Commercial In-Network Plan | Yes | Yes | No | PR-27, PR-96, PR-204 | No |
| Commercial Out-of-Network Plan | No | Yes | No | PR-27, PR-50, PR-96, PR-204 | No |

## Prior authorization periods

| Payer class | Retroactive authorization request accepted within (calendar days after the date of service) | Authorized test must be collected within (calendar days from approval) |
|---|---|---|
| Original Medicare Part B | 0 (none) | 0 (no prior authorization for the class) |
| Medicare Advantage Plan | 0 (none) | 90 |
| Medicare Supplement Plan | 0 (none) | 0 (no prior authorization for the class) |
| Medicaid Managed Care Plan | 14 | 60 |
| TRICARE Prime and Select | 0 (none) | 90 |
| Commercial In-Network Plan | 14 | 90 |
| Commercial Out-of-Network Plan | 0 (none) | 60 |

## Footnotes

a. "None" in the patient-billable column means the payer class lists no denial code whose amount may be transferred to the patient.
b. A retroactive-request figure of 0 means the payer accepts no retroactive authorization request; only Medicaid Managed Care Plan and Commercial In-Network Plan accept one, within 14 calendar days after the date of service.
c. An authorization-validity figure of 0 means the payer class has no prior authorization.
d. PR-50 is patient-billable only for Original Medicare Part B and Commercial Out-of-Network Plan.
